matched_beta_selection.balancing_rule: median within each source task/split/model environment, then median across environments
matched_beta_selection.fallback_rule: fixed_matched_beta when a stage has no valid source rows
matched_beta_selection.held_out_task_rule: one map per held-out task; use only the other three tasks
matched_beta_selection.stage_rule: same environment-balanced median within the stage
matched_beta_selection.tie_rule: deterministic lexical ordering before every grouped reduction
matched_beta_selection.unit: Original-GG effective beta at active-learning rounds >= 0

reuse_rules.GG_NORMALIZED_ACQUISITION: not registered for broad reuse; no RAW identity is assumed

simple_scaling_rule: no outcome-driven simple-scaler winner is selected from sentinel or broad outcomes
